sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
for p,h in r["code_doc_sha256"].items():
    f=Path(p);assert sha((f if f.is_absolute()else root/f).read_bytes())==h,p
def capture(t):
    raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(t["stdout_zlib_base64"],validate=True))
    assert t["rc"]==0 and not t["timed_out"] and sha(raw)==t["stdout_sha256"] and len(raw)==t["stdout_bytes"]
    return json.loads(raw)
d=capture(r["test_run"])["data"]
native=capture(json.loads((root/r["parents"]["native"]["path"]).read_bytes())["test_run"])["data"]

assert v["status"]==0 and v["errors"]==0 and neg["status"]!=0 and neg["errors"]>0 and neg["spirv"]["bytes"]==0
spv=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(v["spirv"]["zlib_base64"]));assert sha(spv)==v["spirv"]["sha256"]

ops=[];i=5
while i<len(w):

assert any(o==17 and a[0]==10 for _,o,a in ops),"Float64 capability"
nc={a[0]for _,o,a in ops if o==71 and a[1]==42}

assert len(arith)==8 and all(a[1]in nc for a in arith)
main=next(a[1]for _,o,a in ops if o==15);active=None;label=None;blocks={}
for pos,o,a in ops:
    if o==54:active=a[1]
    elif o==56:active=None
    elif active==main:
        if o==248:label=a[0];blocks[label]=[]
        else:assert label is not None;blocks[label].append((pos,o,a))
entry=next(iter(blocks));succ={k:([b[-1][2][0]]if b[-1][1]==249 else list(b[-1][2][1:])if b[-1][1]==250 else [])for k,b in blocks.items()}
reachable={entry};todo=[entry]
while todo:
    for k in succ[todo.pop()]:
        if k not in reachable:reachable.add(k);todo.append(k)

changed=True
while changed:
    changed=False
    for k in reachable-{entry}:
        new={k}|set.intersection(*(dom[p]for p in pred[k]))
        if new!=dom[k]:dom[k]=new;changed=True
packs=[(k,pos)for k,b in blocks.items()for pos,o,a in b if o==12 and a[3]==59]
guards=[(k,pos,a)for k,b in blocks.items()for pos,o,a in b if o==199]
assert len(packs)==10 and len(guards)==10
first=min(packs,key=lambda q:q[1])
assert all(k in dom[first[0]] and pos<first[1]for k,pos,a in guards),"ALL raw checks dominate first pack"
for k,pos,a in guards:
    comparison=next((aa for pp,o,aa in blocks[k]if o==170 and aa[2]==a[1]),None);assert comparison
    term=blocks[k][-1];assert term[1]==250 and term[2][0]==comparison[1]
    target=term[2][1];assert blocks[target][-1][1]==253,"nonfinite true branch returns"
g=v["inspection"]["graph"];nodes=g["nodes"]
assert len(nodes)==130 and len(g["helper_calls"])==25 and not g["control_flow_certified"] and not g["GPU_RNE_certified"]
edges=[]
def add(op,a,b):edges.append((op,list(a),list(b)));return ["node",len(edges)-1]
def tw(a,b):
    s=add("+",a,b);bb=add("-",s,a);ab=add("-",s,bb);db=add("-",b,bb);da=add("-",a,ab)
    return s,add("+",da,db)
def plus(a,b):
    h=tw(a[0],b[0]);l=tw(a[1],b[1]);s=tw(h[0],add("+",h[1],l[0]));return tw(s[0],add("+",s[1],l[1]))
src=lambda n:[["source",n+".hi"],["source",n+".lo"]]
t0=plus(plus(src("P0"),src("gamma0")),src("mu"));t1=plus(plus(src("P1"),src("gamma1")),src("mu"));plus(t0,[["neg",p]for p in t1])
assert [(n["op"],n["a"],n["b"])for n in nodes]==edges
assert [list(t0),list(t1)]==[[["node",46],["node",51]],[["node",98],["node",103]]]
runs={x["id"]:x for x in native["runs"]};good=[]

    good.append(case["id"]);inp=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(q["input"]["zlib_base64"]));out=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(q["expected_output"]["zlib_base64"]))
    assert len(inp)==96 and len(out)==64 and struct.unpack("<4I",inp[:16])==(0x54504731,10,2,1) and struct.unpack("<4I",out[:16])==(0x54504731,6,2,1)
    f=native["registry"][case["id"]]["fixture"]
    words=[rr[p]["word_le_hex"]for rr in f["rows"][:2]for p in("hi","lo")]+[e[p]for e in old["encodings"]for p in("hi","lo")]
    assert inp[16:]==b"".join(bytes.fromhex(h)for h in words)
    assert out[16:]==b"".join(bytes.fromhex(rr[p])for rr in old["rows"]for p in("hi","lo"))
    source=dict(zip(g["source_order"],words));trace=old["trace"]
    def bits(ref):
        tag,x=ref
        if tag=="source":return source[x]
        if tag=="node":return trace[x]["y"]
        assert tag=="neg";return(int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(bits(x)),"little")^(1<<63)).to_bytes(8,"little").hex()
    assert len(trace)==130
    for node,t in zip(nodes,trace):assert (node["op"],bits(node["a"]),bits(node["b"]))==(t["op"],t["a"],t["b"])
assert len(good)==11 and len(d["preparations"])==46 and len(d["traces"])==11

for p in d["prefix"]:

    if ":"in p["id"]:assert rr["packs"]==[]
assert len(d["selector_mutations"])==8 and all(x["result"]["status"]=="STOP"for x in d["selector_mutations"])
